game_title: Type Cast Forge – Vent Garden Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden, a garden growing near vents: the fire warden must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Cast Forge: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden: a garden growing near vents
core_gameplay_loop: In Vent Garden, repeat each round: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes. Each round, smoke serpents strike the ash barrier, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the forge_heat value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ash barrier from smoke serpents in Vent Garden: keep the forge_heat meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 34-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: forge_heat drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 34-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 5 (applied tier): Type Cast Forge
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how forge_heat changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Vent Garden.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 34 seconds while forge_heat > 0.
